reason: Separate the target-time cold start of LinUCB from the restriction on source information; retain both protocols regardless of outcome.
primary_protocol_unchanged: protocol.json defines T0 deployment of a zero-initialized LinUCB selector, not whole-system shared burn-in.
sensitivity: LinUCB with pre-period initialization on the held-out zone, using source-prefix-selected hyperparameters, width edges and TSC configuration.
trajectory: Join source matured prefix, separately reconstructed prefix_pending records, and the original target suffix. Replay each price continuously in issue order with the original selected-action feedback rule and a continuous pending queue.
evaluation: Store and evaluate only actions issued at or after T0; use the identical target records and complete post-T0 168-hour windows as primary results.
temporal_interpretation: Hyperparameters are selected at T0; the prefix is a historical replay used for initialization, not a claim of actual historical deployment of those choices.
no_target_tuning: Neither prefix nor suffix of the outer held-out zone is used to choose hyperparameters or select the preferred report version.
reporting: Always report cold and pre-period-initialized LinUCB. Extra local training information of warm version is explicit. No new forecaster training.
